scope: Independent engineering review of candidate 00000002899 only. No Lean project/build executed by this reviewer. No other candidate proofs or reports read.
coverage_observed: Manifest hashes cover all discovered submitted Lean sources outside .lake, .git, evidence. Exact supplied toolchain and Lake manifest pins compared.
Token scan erases comments and strings and rejects listed incomplete or bypass terms; it is not a general metaprogramming safety verifier.
Fresh private stock/dependency copies are checked against pinned Git blobs; every submitted Lean module is replayed with warningAsError after Lake build.
Owned .olean inventory rejects missing or unexpected products. Import resolution rejects duplicate locations and byte-matches package imports to pre-build stock cache.
Audit selects roots by originating module; graph collects type, value, recursor and inductive links. All safe roots must have permitted axioms and no unsafe dependencies.
Controls include good/projection/constructor/recursor fixture and rejection of direct axiom, transitive opaque axiom, sorry, native_decide and unsafe declaration.
independent_checks_planned: Frozen manifest and current submitted bytes; replay-copy source identity; pins; driver/template identity; command output hashes and exit codes.
Module inventory and all roots; exact capstone membership/type with permitted safe-root trust; graph closure recomputation independent of exported summaries.
Config and all submitted source side-effect review, including non-Lean files and Lean command/metaprogram constructs.
Generated unsafe compiler helper origin/classification and absence from safe-root closure.
limits: Cached dependencies are not rebuilt and Lean runtime is not bootstrapped.
Dependency graph export and its Python check do not recheck Lean kernel judgments or independently re-extract the Lean environment. Fresh source compilation supplies kernel checking.
PATH network wrappers are safeguards, not OS isolation.
Lake configuration and metaprogrammatic/auxiliary code require independent side-effect inspection.
Driver baseline covers runtime lean/lake and dylibs; runtime .olean import hashes are recorded after compilation without a pre-build runtime .olean baseline.
The graph checker trusts permitted_axioms and trust_enforced fields; independent checks must enforce fixed policy and consistency of those flags.
This engineering review alone does not establish mathematical statement alignment or complete PDF/LaTeX correctness.
